reasoning.notes: Text LLM for the interview reasoning stage. An anthropic_messages-compatible endpoint also exists; MiniMax rejects image_url blocks on that endpoint (use Anthropic image blocks).

optional.headers.language: BCP-47 hint (zh/yue/en/ja/ko/th/vi/id/ms/fil/ar/tr/fr/de/es/it/pt/pl/ru/uk). Omitted by default so mixed-language recognition stays on; override via extras {"stt_request": {"headers": {"language": "zh"}}}.
optional.fields.response_format: json | verbose_json | srt | vtt (verbose_json/srt/vtt add diarization+timestamps and cannot combine with stream)
optional.fields.stream: true = SSE incremental output, requires response_format=json

recognize.notes: Audio uploaded as wav (converted from PCM); raw PCM is not accepted. The language header is intentionally absent by default.

optional.voice_setting.emotion: happy | sad | angry | fearful | disgusted | surprised | calm | fluent | whisper (auto by default; fluent/whisper only on 2.6, whisper unsupported on 2.8)
optional.voice_setting.text_normalization: boolean; CN/EN normalization, improves number reading
optional.timbre_weights: voice blending, up to 4 items {voice_id, weight}; leave voice_setting.voice_id empty when used
optional.voice_modify: {pitch, intensity, timbre} in [-100,100] or one sound_effects value

pause.notes: Insert between pronounceable text; never consecutive; paragraphs split by newline.

pronunciation.notes: Inline replacement in ASCII parentheses with tone digits: Mandarin pinyin tones 1-5, IPA, or Cantonese jyutping tones 1-6. E.g. (he2), (lɪv), (sung3).

interjections.notes: ASCII parentheses, lowercase, inserted inline; only these two models support them.

limits.chunk_note: Text over 3000 chars should use streaming; the HTTP adapter splits long text at paragraph/sentence boundaries and concatenates the mp3/flac/opus/pcm chunks (wav chunks cannot be concatenated, only the first chunk is returned).

speak.notes: Non-streaming T2A HTTP. Streaming (stream=true or the websocket endpoints) is not wired yet; interview turns are sentence-level and stay well under the chunk limit.
